# netactuate_router_vrf_bgp_neighbor (Resource)

Beta. The cloud router family is in beta: behaviour and schema may change. Manages a BGP neighbour in a cloud router VRF.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_router_vrf_bgp_neighbor" "example" {
  address    = "192.0.2.10"
  remote_asn = 64512
  router_id  = 12345
  vrf_id     = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `address` (String) The IP address of the neighbor.
- `remote_asn` (Number) The ASN for your neighbor.
- `router_id` (Number) The ID of the cloud router.
- `vrf_id` (Number) The ID of the VRF.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A description for the BGP neighbor.
- `do_as_override` (Boolean) If true, this enabled as-override, overriding the ASN in outbound updates to your local ASN. This may be required if you peer with magic mesh or the cloud router from multiple peers that share the same ASN.
- `do_next_hop_self` (Boolean) If true, this enables nexthop-self, which is very common for eBGP peering.
- `ebgp_multihop` (Number) The ebgp-multihop configuration for the neighbor.
- `export_default_drop` (Boolean) If true, drop all routes that don't match a rule on export. If false, allow them by default.
- `export_rules` (Block List) A list of routing rules on export. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--export_rules))
- `import_default_drop` (Boolean) If true, drop all routes that don't match a rule on import. If false, allow them by default.
- `import_rules` (Block List) A list of routing rules on import. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--import_rules))
- `ipv4_enabled` (Boolean) Whether or not to enable the IPv4 address family.
- `ipv6_enabled` (Boolean) Whether or not to enable the IPv6 address family.
- `is_shutdown` (Boolean) Whether or not the neighbor is administratively shut down.
- `md5_secret` (String, Sensitive) The MD5 secret with your neighbor.
- `name` (String) Name your BGP neighbor something if you want to.
- `source_address` (String) The IP address to optionally use as the source when establishing the BGP session.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `neighbor_id` (Number) The ID of the BGP neighbor.

### Nested Schema for `export_rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) What to do when matching the prefix list.
- `prefix_list_id` (Number) The ID of the prefix list.

Optional:

- `prepend_last_asn` (Number) How many times to prepend the last ASN in the as-path.


<a id="nestedblock--import_rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `import_rules`

Required:

- `action` (String) What to do when matching the prefix list.
- `prefix_list_id` (Number) The ID of the prefix list.

Optional:

- `set_local_preference` (Number) The local preference value.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_router_vrf_bgp_neighbor.example 12345
```
